ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router for rapid prompt engineering workshops and dynamic multi-LLM cost optimization.
ideas.title: PromptRoute Studio
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly ties into Celestia 2.0's Prompt Engineering Workshop theme while solving a practical developer pain point of LLM token routing costs.

ideas.pitch: An automated pre-deployment compliance auditor for open-source AI workflows using human-in-the-loop BPMN orchestration.
ideas.title: BPMN-AuditAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings rigorous enterprise governance patterns to an open innovation hackathon, appealing to judges looking for production-ready architecture.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent IoT diagnostic and closed-loop operations platform for tracking and minimizing real-time hardware energy consumption.
ideas.title: EcoLog Multi-Agent Carbon Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Merges hardware awareness with autonomous agents, capturing points in both the SDG and Hardware tracks through complex multi-layered telemetry.

ideas.pitch: A federated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server environment that securely bridges disparate hospital databases for localized clinical AI agents.
ideas.title: MedMCP Federated Clinical Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles the notoriously difficult problem of medical data privacy and integration using cutting-edge MCP federation architecture.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first Socratic reasoning tutor that uses local SLMs and efficient reinforcement learning to adapt to student learning curves.
ideas.title: AdaptiveClassroom AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on pedagogical efficacy and low-latency local execution, making it highly practical for under-resourced educational environments.
